subject: Pre-demo security preflight blocking live walkthrough
messages:
From: Natalie Ulbrich <natalie@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@halcyonhealth.com
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling walkthrough — procurement preflight items

Hi Sean / Monica,

Thanks for the calendar invite for next Tuesday. Procurement ran our standard supplier-risk questionnaire and Legal flagged a handful of prerequisites we need completed before a live, exec-facing demo can go ahead:

- Signed DPA (Legal)
- SOC 2 Type II attestation summary or AICPA letter (security)
- SSO / IdP integration details (metadata, supported protocols)
- Signed vendor onboarding form (Procurement)

I've attached the partially completed supplier-risk form so you can see the exact asks (Halcyon_Supplier_Risk_Form.pdf). Our procurement and the execs will not attend a live walkthrough until these are acknowledged. Also — heads up — our clinical leadership is traveling June 2–4, so even if we cleared the gating items, the exec demo window next week would still be awkward.

Two asks: can you confirm which of the above you can provide this week, and whether Redwood can do a short technical pre-brief (20–30m) with our IT/security team that would be non-executive while Legal finishes the DPA? If so, we can plan a tentative reschedule for the exec demo the week after (w/c June 8).

Thanks,
Natalie
Natalie Ulbrich
Head of Procurement, Halcyon Health
Attachments: Halcyon_Supplier_Risk_Form.pdf (application/pdf, 92 KB)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Ulbrich <natalie@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling walkthrough — procurement preflight items

Hi Natalie — appreciate the heads up and the PDF.

Summary of what we can provide quickly:
- DPA: we have a standard DPA and can send a DocuSign link today for Halcyon review. (link: https://www.docusign.com/link/DPA-HALCYON-8742)
- SOC2: we can share our SOC 2 summary and the auditor letter this afternoon (redacted as required).
- SSO/IdP: Karthik can produce SAML/OIDC metadata and a short integration checklist.
- Vendor onboarding: Monica will fill the procurement-specific fields in the supplier form and return a marked-up version.

Agreed about travel — sounds like execs will be out June 2–4. We can do the technical pre-brief with Halcyon IT/security next week (non-exec, 20–30m) and push the exec demo to the week of June 8. If a live demo still needs execs, we'll ask product to hold a 45–60m slot and tentatively pencil June 9 at 10:00 PT; happy to move that once Legal is done.

Karthik / Monica — can you confirm you can deliver the SSO metadata and our SOC2 summary by COB Monday (June 1)? If not, propose an asynchronous alternative (recorded 15m demo + short Q&A on the pre-brief).

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Ulbrich <natalie@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling walkthrough — procurement preflight items

On Sat, May 30, 2026 at 11:03 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik / Monica — can you confirm you can deliver the SSO metadata and our SOC2 summary by COB Monday (June 1)?

Yep — I can get the SSO metadata bundle and SAML example responses out today. I'll also attach a one-page SOC2 summary and the link to the full auditor letter (redacted) for Halcyon to review.

Two quick asks from our side to speed procurement sign-off:
1) For the supplier-risk form, please point to the exact fields that require vendor-attested values versus fields Halcyon can accept an inline note on (e.g., "Redwood to provide SOC2 letter on or before June 4"). That will reduce back-and-forth.
2) If the execs are traveling, would Halcyon accept an async recording of the product walkthrough for execs, followed by a 20-min Q&A once DPA is signed? We can keep a tentative live slot for June 9 and switch to record+short Q&A if Legal needs more time.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_onepager.pdf (application/pdf, 48 KB), sso_metadata_bundle.zip (archive/zip, 12 KB)
From: Natalie Ulbrich <natalie@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling walkthrough — procurement preflight items

Thanks, Sean and Karthik — this is helpful.

Procurement will accept the inline-notes approach for a couple of non-critical fields if you include ETA commitments (e.g., SOC2 letter by June 4). We'd like the DPA signed before exec-facing sessions; DocuSign link noted.

We'll take the technical pre-brief next week with your engineering team — propose Tues, June 8 at 09:00 PT for a 30-minute slot (IT/security only). For execs, we approve a recorded walkthrough to share with clinical leadership while Legal closes the DPA; please send a tentative calendar invite for Wed, June 9 at 10:00 PT for the live slot and we'll confirm or convert to recorded-as-needed.

I'll route the supplier form back with inline notes by Tuesday midday. If you can send the SOC2 one-pager and SSO metadata now (Karthik's attachments), that will let our security team start validation before the pre-brief.

Appreciate the flexibility — speak Tues.

Natalie
Head of Procurement, Halcyon Health
(End of thread)
